title: Terminal Illness & End-of-Life Planning in Tajikistan: 5-Step Official Checklist
titleEn: Terminal Illness & End-of-Life Planning in Tajikistan: 5-Step Official Checklist
cardSummary: Official 5-step serious and terminal illness checklist for Tajikistan: palliative care coordination, advance directives, powers of attorney, disability and caregiver support, and estate preparation.
introHtml: Because Tajikistan's domestic statutory and agency portals are only partially accessible online or in English, this guide draws on verified international legal archives (WIPO Lex, FAOLEX, CIS Legislation, and HCCH) alongside accessible Tajik government service portals [1] [2] [6] [8]. We outline five practical administrative steps for families coordinating healthcare, legal representation, disability pensions, and estate planning for a seriously or terminally ill person in Tajikistan [1] [3] [4].

steps.title: Coordinate medical care, clinical records, and consent
steps.html:
• Engage public healthcare and symptom support: Medical institutions supervised by the Ministry of Health and Social Protection of the Population coordinate inpatient care, district clinic (polyclinic) outpatient management, and pain-relief prescriptions [7] [8].
  • Verify emergency and specialist referrals: Keep the treating physician's summary and polyclinic medical card up to date so hospital transfers or home nursing evaluations proceed without delay [7] [8].
  • Document treatment communication preferences: Ask attending specialists directly how diagnosis updates and treatment consent discussions are documented for family caregivers while the patient retains legal capacity [1] [7].

steps.title: Execute a notarized Power of Attorney before capacity narrows
steps.html:
• Establish formal representation early: Under the Civil Code of the Republic of Tajikistan (Law No. 1918 of December 24, 2022), written agency requires a notarized Power of Attorney when an authorized representative will handle property, banking, civil status certificates, or pension collections [1] [2] [9].
  • Arrange state notary certification: Contact a state notary office under the Ministry of Justice of the Republic of Tajikistan (or arrange a home or hospital notary visit if the ill person cannot travel); foreign nationals should also verify whether consular certification is needed [6] [9].
  • Avoid court incapacity delays: Waiting until severe cognitive decline leaves no valid Power of Attorney in place requires formal court guardianship or trusteeship proceedings under the Civil Code, which slows urgent banking and care decisions [1] [2].

steps.title: Apply for disability evaluation, pensions, and caregiver support
steps.html:
• Request medical-social disability assessment: Ask the treating clinic to refer the patient to the state medical-social examination board so disability group classification and state disability pensions or social allowances can be assessed [7] [8].
  • Set up authorized pension collection or bank routing: Confirm whether monthly pensions or social assistance payments arrive via state bank accounts or postal delivery, and link a notarized Power of Attorney if a family member collects or manages funds [1] [8].
  • Confirm language and translation readiness: Official forms and medical-social expertise filings operate in Tajik or Russian; engage a qualified interpreter early if foreign family members assist [6] [9].

steps.title: Draft or review a will and cross-border estate records
steps.html:
• Prepare a notarized will: Under Part Three (Section VI: Succession Law) of the Civil Code of the Republic of Tajikistan, a person with legal capacity may execute a written will certified by a state notary to specify property distribution [3].
  • Account for statutory reserved shares: Even when a will exists, Tajik succession rules protect mandatory shares for minor or disabled dependents, so reviewing asset plans with a state notary avoids future disputes [3] [9].
  • Verify Hague Apostille rules for foreign documents: If a Power of Attorney or civil record will later be presented abroad (or executed abroad for use in Tajikistan), recall that Tajikistan is a 1961 Hague Apostille Convention party (in force 31 October 2015), with the Ministry of Justice of the Republic of Tajikistan and the Main Consular Department of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs serving as Competent Authorities [5] [6].

steps.title: Organize property deeds, bank records, and identity documents
steps.html:
• Audit ownership titles and contracts: Gather property ownership certificates, land-use or housing books, vehicle documents, and loan or utility agreements into one folder [1] [3].
  • Confirm tax and passport status: Ensure national ID cards, foreign residence registrations, and tax numbers remain current, and verify that any foreign family passports or powers of attorney are readily accessible via the Main Consular Department of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs where consular authentication applies [5] [6].

closingQuestion: Is your family member currently receiving care in Dushanbe or another region of Tajikistan, and would you like details on state notary powers of attorney or disability filings first?

contacts.name: Ministry of Health and Social Protection of the Population
contacts.note: Oversees public hospitals, clinical treatment guidelines, disability examination boards, and social protection benefits.

contacts.note: Supervises state notary offices (for powers of attorney and wills), ZAGS civil registries, and Apostille authentication.

contacts.name: Main Consular Department of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
contacts.note: Handles diplomatic consular inquiries and Apostille certification for archive and educational documents.
